before.body_html:
Hi Josh,

Fair point — and honestly it works either way. Some people come in because something's bothering them (desk-related neck, back, shoulder stuff is most common). Others use it as a kind of MOT, find out what's tight or compensating, and sort it before it becomes a problem. The free session's just a way to find out which camp you're in, no commitment either way.

Since you're remote, you can book whichever clinic suits you best when you do come into town, or we can work around your schedule. Here's the link: https://onebodyldn.connect.tm3app.com/book/services/physiotherapy/physiotherapy_55min_1

Use code OBLACCESS55. There's a small £4.99 booking fee that holds your slot. If you've got private health insurance, we can run later sessions through that too — often ends up costing you nothing.

Let me know if you need anything else.

Best
Rebecca
